explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to plants with OAI classifications and warning letters before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the sterile water shortage on 2021-11-23 and it has remained current for 59 months as of 2026-10-21.
An FDA inspection of Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited ended 2019-09-06 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2020-05-25 — 547 days before the shortage posting.
FDA issued a Warning Letter to Pfizer Healthcare India Private Limited on 2020-03-25 — 608 days before the shortage posting.
FDA issued a Warning Letter to Nephron SC, LLC on 2020-09-22 — 427 days before the shortage posting.
FDA's OAI classification letter to Hospira, Inc. is dated 2020-04-22 — 580 days before the shortage posting.
The rule-identified best option is to buy from American Regent, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose plant last received a VAI classification on 2024-04-24.

memory.text: Decision on cisplatin: transfer cisplatin between Corvale hospitals weekly instead of buying grey-market stock. Rationale: Grey-market offers were 6 to 10 times contract price with unverifiable pedigree (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-0004fd.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%water%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%water%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-fdd27c.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('87d6e9dc-fe3b-4593-ac9a-d7493d1959c7', '2b9ea23a-f9e9-48a8-25b7-519e3bbd6828', 'bc04a883-babc-87a6-e053-2995a90a3dfd') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-a2a6c1.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%water%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-392e9e.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00409397703', '00409488710', '00487610501')

Q-cf9f2e.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%water%'
